text: dsh-session-port 是面向 DSH Web 的会话打包与恢复插件。在会话头部提供 Export、Import 操作，并通过 HTTP 路由处理归档：导出会话日志、子代理记录、媒体和引用的工作区文件为 ZIP；导入 ZIP 时恢复这些内容并重新关联工作区；还可修复已导入会话的工作区关联与标题投影。适合需要在 DSH 实例或工作区之间迁移会话的用户。安装使用 DSH 插件命令，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-session-port adds Export and Import to the DSH Web session header. Export creates a ZIP of session logs, subagents, media, and referenced workspace files. Import restores the archive and reconnects its session to a workspace; Repair can restore that connection and refresh the title.
想把一个 DSH 会话连同相关文件打包成 ZIP 带到另一台机器。
如何导入会话记录、媒体和工作区文件，并让会话重新归到对应工作区？
I need to export a DSH session and its referenced workspace files into one ZIP archive.
dsh-session-port 的功能「导出会话包」：在会话头部点击 Export，下载 ZIP；归档包含会话日志、子代理记录、媒体和引用的工作区文件，也可通过导出路由选择 referenced 或 workspace 范围。
dsh-session-port 的功能「导入与修复会话」：从会话头部选择 ZIP 后导入到当前会话工作区，恢复会话、媒体和文件并关联工作区；另有 Repair 路由重新关联已导入会话并刷新标题投影。

dsh-session-port README · dsh-session-port：Port a session in and out of DeepSeek Harness — bundle one session into a single ZIP and restore it anywhere.

[中文](README_zh.md)

dsh-session-port README · What it does：Export a session with everything it references — the log (root + subagents), media, and the workspace files — into one archive, then import that archive on another DSH, fully restored and re-attached to its workspace.

dsh-session-port README · What it does：| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Export** | Streams one ZIP: manifest → logs → subagents → media → referenced workspace files |
| **Import** | Restores sessions, media, and workspace files; remaps paths; auto-attaches the session to its workspace |
| **Repair** | Re-attaches an imported session and re-folds its title (fixes "ungrouped" / missing name) |

dsh-session-port README · Install：Requires Node.js ≥ 22.10 and `pnpm` (`dsh plugin` uses pnpm underneath).

```sh

dsh-session-port README · From GitHub (default branch, or pin a tag)：dsh plugin --profile web add "github:seth-hg/dsh-session-port"
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:seth-hg/dsh-session-port#v0.1.4"
section: From GitHub (default branch, or pin a tag)

text:
dsh-session-port README · From a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-session-port
```

Restart `dsh web`. Two **Export / Import** buttons appear in the session header.

dsh-session-port README · From the session header：- **Export** — downloads `session-port-<id>.zip`.
- **Import** — pick a `.zip`; it restores into the current session's workspace (the header cwd).

Import also accepts DSH's built-in session-log export (the header `/export` download): it restores the root session, subagents, and media. That export carries no workspace files, so none are expected.
dsh-session-port README · From the HTTP routes (loopback-trusted)：```sh
dsh-session-port README · Export (scope=referenced by default, or workspace)：curl 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/wsx/session-pack?sessionId=<id>&scope=referenced' -o out.zip

dsh-session-port README · Import into a workspace (path remap: old::new)：curl -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/wsx/session-pack/import?workspace=/path/to/workspace&remap=/old::/new' \
  --data-binary @out.zip
section: Import into a workspace (path remap: old::new)

dsh-session-port README · Repair an imported session (re-attach + re-fold title)：curl -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/wsx/session-pack/repair?sessionId=<id>'
```
section: Repair an imported session (re-attach + re-fold title)

text:
dsh-session-port README · HTTP API：| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/wsx/session-pack?sessionId=<id>&scope=referenced\|workspace&level=0-9` | GET | Stream the ZIP archive |
| `/wsx/session-pack/import?workspace=<dir>&remap=<old>::<new>` | POST | Restore an archive (JSON summary) |
| `/wsx/session-pack/repair?sessionId=<id>` | POST | Re-attach + re-fold title (idempotent) |
